name: Augment Code
desc: Context engine indexing large codebases for agent context
desc_zh: 面向大型代码库构建上下文引擎，为编码 Agent 提供高保真上下文
solves: Big codebases overwhelm built-in autocomplete. It indexes the whole repo so suggestions know the code around yours.
solves_zh: 代码库一大，内置补全就顶不住了。它给整个仓库建索引，让补全知道你正在写的代码周围是什么。
best_for: When your repo is too large for your editor to hold in context.
best_for_zh: 仓库大到编辑器装不进上下文的时候。
